blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
You took a fixed desktop portfolio and made it work on every screen size without touching a single line of HTML. rem units, media queries, mobile-first CSS, flex-wrap, a hamburger menu, fluid images.
Open any project, resize the browser, see what's wrong, and fix it. You have the tools now.
Ready to keep going? The next course is Make Your Website Interactive, where you'll learn JavaScript and bring your portfolio to life.
See you in the next course.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
